title: Agent start and work claim can strand reservations when Git setup fails
description: Evidence: agent start and work claim call claimExactWork/claimNextWork before attachGitBranchForClaim; runtime claim already writes reservation, work item, and work.claimed event. If git switch/worktree setup fails afterward, the work remains in_progress with an active reservation but no usable branch/worktree metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Branch/worktree preflight happens before reservation mutation, or failed attach rolls back/releases the reservation.
Tests cover agent start and work claim --worktree Git failures and assert no active reservation remains and the work is still claimable.
